text_block_list.text:
For today's training, Нарита Таисин asks for
help building her strength.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Just as I arrive at the gym, I see the stern
athlete about to lift a
barbell.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: All right, I've got this...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
She yanks it up, but the weight's
momentum throws her off balance!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: So... heavy!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I help hold the barbell and slowly lower it
to the floor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Gasp... Gasp... Damn it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
It would probably be a good idea to warm
up before she gets herself
hurt.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What? You saying I can't handle it?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
That anyone as scrawny as me should just
give up?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
It's clear the irritated trainee has enough
strength to lift the barbell.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But she needs to slow down and warm up
properly first. I try to
explain why.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Though she appears reluctant, the
stubborn student does as
instructed for
now.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I assign some light jogging on the treadmill
to raise her body temp
and heart rate,
then cap it off with stretching to loosen
her muscles.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Having finished the comprehensive
warm-up, Нарита Таисин once
again stands
before the barbell.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hgh... Hng!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
This time, she's a lot steadier, and she's
able to lift the barbell with
no problem.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I did it!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: Looks like you've got the hang of it.

text_block_list.text: A little, I guess.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Her words express some doubt, but she's
got it down.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Dumbbell training is going smoothly, but it
could be better if I
adjusted her shaky
posture...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
Can you straighten out your upper body a little
more?

text_block_list.text: ...I'll try.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
For the rest of the training, she seems to
take my instructions more
willingly than
before.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With the workout finished, I go over the
day's accomplishments.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: How'd you feel with today's training?

text_block_list.text: Um... Fine, I guess.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Oh, right. Hey, um...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I think I might wanna do that warm-up you
showed me from now on.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
It made things... Well, my body felt easier
to move, I think.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I can't hide my excitement. I wasn't
expecting such a positive
response from
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what the heck... Chill out, would
you?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Are we done wrapping up? Cause I'm
gonna split.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Though training seems to be going well
with her...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There are still some obstacles to overcome
before we can truly be
partners.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
